title: Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026 Review: SMOKE10's Siquijor Island 42K
seo_title: Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026 Review | Siquijor Philippines
meta_description: Isla Del Fuego Marathon 2026: September 6 on Siquijor Island. SMOKE10's full marathon on the 'Island of Fire' — the Philippines' most mystical race destination.
dek: Set for 6 September 2026 on Siquijor Island — the 'Island of Fire' — this SMOKE10 Events marathon brings a full 42K to the Philippines' most mystical island.
verdict: The Isla Del Fuego Marathon (Island of Fire) is a SMOKE10 Events production on Siquijor — the Philippines' most mystical island, known for its folk-healing traditions, pristine beaches, and firefly-lit nights. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K). Siquijor's coastal ring road provides a scenic, flat-to-rolling course with ocean views. September is the tail of the wet season in the Visayas. For runners wanting a Philippine island marathon with genuine atmosphere and off-the-beaten-path appeal, this is a standout.
